fraud.text:
xi.	(a) Based on examination of the books and records of the Company and according to the information and explanations given to us, considering the principles of materiality outlined in Standards on Auditing, we report that no fraud by the Company or on the Company has been noticed or reported during the course of the audit.

(b)	In our opinion and according to the information and explanations given to us, no report under sub-section (12) of Section 143 of the Companies Act, 2013 has been filed by the auditors in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under Rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government.

operating_notes.text: Company acquired TProcess Inc. for 1.07 million to strengthen transit IP assets.
Order book exceeded ₹1,800 crore at the start of FY27, with 68%-72% expected to be executable in the next 12 months.
Aurionpro announced a USD 33 million fintech engagement, its largest order win in the US market.
Aurionpro secured an order from Matkahuolto for contactless validation and payment technology in Finland, marking its entry into the European market.
Partnered with Mastercard to bring contactless transit payments to North American public transportation agencies.
Board approved amalgamation of three wholly owned subsidiaries with Aurionpro Solutions.
Board approved scheme of amalgamation for three wholly owned subsidiaries: Aurofidel Outsourcing Limited, Intellvisions Solutions Private Limited, and Skanan Hardware Private Limited.

timeline.summary: CRISIL upgraded Aurionpro Solutions' long-term bank loan rating to A/Stable and short-term rating to A1, with total facilities enhanced to ₹427 Cr.
Aurionpro Solutions recommended a final dividend of ₹2 per share for FY26 following an unmodified audit report.
Aurionpro Solutions reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹345.6 Cr and PAT of ₹61.5 Cr, and recommended a final dividend of ₹2 per share.
Aurionpro Solutions reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹346 Cr and PAT of ₹62 Cr.
Prabhakar Kelkar and Ninad Kelkar shared the Q4 & FY2026 earnings call recording link on May 12, 2026.
Aurionpro Solutions released the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on May 12, 2026.
2026-05-21: Aurionpro announces a USD 33 million fintech engagement, its largest order win in the US market.
Aurionpro Solutions Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings call on July 28, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹358 Cr, up 6.3% YoY, with EBITDA at ₹61 Cr (17% margin) and PAT at ₹45 Cr.
Aurionpro Solutions was selected by Matkahuolto as device vendor for its cEMV project in Finland, marking the company's entry into the European market.
Aurionpro Transit partnered with Mastercard to deploy contactless payment solutions for public transportation across North America.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹414.98 Cr (+16.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹48.97 Cr (-9.9% YoY).
Aurionpro Solutions board approved the amalgamation of three wholly owned subsidiaries, Aurofidel Outsourcing Limited, Intellvisions Solutions Private Limited, and Skanan Hardware Private Limited.
